name: zaira-guide
description: Research and compare developer tools with the read-only Zaira Guide MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Find and compare agent-ready developer tools.
interface.longDescription: Search the current Zaira Guide, inspect individual tools, and compare shortlisted options using a hosted read-only MCP server. No API key is required. OpenClaw connects through the pinned mcp-remote@0.1.38 stdio bridge.
defaultPrompt: Find the best developer tools for this job.
Compare these tools for an autonomous agent.
Check whether this tool is agent-ready.
